description: Bundled Reno/Sparks/North Valleys major-road geometry for the fleet simulation. This display-derived graph is not a navigational routing database.

encoding.links: Ramp (_link) classes use their parent road class.
encoding.processing: Keep original quantized geometry, including bridge and tunnel continuations; split parts at the capture boundary; remove consecutive duplicate coordinates and identical/reversed duplicate lines. Runtime joins shared points and nearby loose ends using the existing graph builder.
